metric_expectations.source_text: Out-of-sample Sharpe >= 1.0 net of modeled costs.
DSR > 1.0 at 95% confidence given actual trial count.
Max drawdown <= 20% in any walk-forward fold.
Parameter sensitivity: +/-25% parameter shift keeps Sharpe within 70% of baseline.

metric_expectations.source_text: No single 90-day window contributes > 60% of total PnL.

Preserved from D2-006 but not compared because REC v1 realized_metrics copy OL metrics and OL-0028 does not include free_parameter_count.

realized_metrics.window_convention: WP-12dl / WP-S2c-75 uses the final local data-year evaluation window, 2025-04-12 through 2026-04-11, as H-003 combined R1+R2 cycle 1 after the original full-period no-formal-split retrospective baseline. Indicators are warmed up on prior available 1d history, but the backtest window starts flat with no pre-window position carry-in. The original H-003 REP-0004 evidence used a full-period retrospective posture, so strict non-overlap against that baseline is impossible; this report records explicit non-cloned bounded-window disclosure for additional REP evidence.

metric_comparisons.comparison_notes: D2-006 requires out-of-sample Sharpe >= 1.0 net of modeled costs; OL-0028 records sharpe above that threshold.
D2-006 uses strict gt semantics for DSR > 1.0; OL-0028 records dsr equal to 1.0, not greater than 1.0.
D2-006 requires max drawdown <= 20% in any walk-forward fold; OL-0028 records max_drawdown above that threshold.
D2-006 requires parameter sensitivity min_ratio >= 0.70; OL-0028 records sensitivity_min_ratio below that threshold.
D2-006 requires walk-forward efficiency > 0.5; OL-0028 records walk_forward_efficiency above that threshold.

interpretation: REC-0043 derives from OL-0028 and is the WP-S2c-75 H-003 d2_006_gates cycle 1 REC under approved combined R1+R2 methodology. It is the second REC observation for the exact segment H-003 / research_oos / pre_wp_5b / d2_006_gates, increasing the exact segment count from 1 to 2. It does not satisfy REC-5 and does not floor-cross the segment. Cost-drag is preserved but not deterministically compared because OL-0028.metrics.gross_pnl <= 0 makes cost_drag_fraction semantically uninterpretable as a pass/fail ratio. OL-0028 is reused by REC-0044 for the separate exp_success_criteria exact segment under R1 paired-source reuse; separate REC artifacts and separate expectation-source comparisons preserve exact-segment separation. REC-0043 does not create H-003 completion, A2C-002 completion, Path B, policy, scoring, ranking/recommendation, paper-live/runtime, lifecycle, promotion, demotion, protected-path authority, or downstream authority.
notes: WP-12dl creates REC-0043 from new committed OL-0028 against committed D2-006 expectations. It moves H-003 / research_oos / pre_wp_5b / d2_006_gates from reconciliation_count = 1 to 2, still below REC-5 target 3. The same source OL supports REC-0044 for exp_success_criteria under approved R1 paired-source reuse, with separate expectation-source comparison and exact-segment counting.
